components.name: button
components.description: A native button with explicit type and visual emphasis.
components.accessibility: Uses a real button. Choose type="submit" inside a form; the default button never submits accidentally. Disabled buttons remain native disabled controls. Visible text supplies the accessible name.

components.name: link
components.description: A native navigation link with optional visual emphasis.
components.accessibility: Use meaningful link text. Internal hrefs receive ordinary Portal mount resolution. Do not use this as a fake disabled button.

components.name: badge
components.description: A compact textual status marker.
components.accessibility: Text communicates status; colour is supplementary. This component does not announce changes as a live region.

components.name: card
components.description: A panel with optional header and footer.
components.accessibility: Choose heading levels in caller content to match the page hierarchy; Card does not force an h2 or region label.

components.name: alert
components.description: A static notice with optional heading and actions.
components.accessibility: Static notices do not use role=alert, avoiding unsolicited announcements on page load. Dynamic error announcements require the host runtime contract.

components.name: separator
components.description: A semantic horizontal thematic break.
components.accessibility: Preserve semantic HTML and visible focus styles when customizing.

components.name: container
components.description: A centered content-width container.
components.accessibility: Preserve semantic HTML and visible focus styles when customizing.

components.name: stack
components.description: A vertical or horizontal flex layout with token spacing.
components.accessibility: Preserve semantic HTML and visible focus styles when customizing.

components.name: grid
components.description: A responsive grid that collapses on narrow screens.
components.accessibility: DOM order remains reading and keyboard order. Do not use CSS to change meaningful content order.

components.name: field
components.description: A label, description and error wrapper for an explicitly identified control.
components.accessibility: The for prop must equal the nested control id. Also set required on the control. When using description/error, provide descriptionId/errorId and pass those same ids to the nested control describedby prop (space-separated if both). Mark the control invalid=true for an error. IDs must be unique in the document.

components.name: input
components.description: A native single-line input with label/error association.
components.accessibility: Always provide a visible associated label. Placeholder is not a label. Pass a unique id for each repeated control. File inputs do not gain upload capability from this component.

components.name: textarea
components.description: A native multiline control.
components.accessibility: Always provide a visible associated label. The value is text content, not an HTML value attribute.

components.name: select
components.description: A native select with caller-owned option elements.
components.accessibility: Use option/optgroup elements in the default slot. Set selected on the desired option; the component has no browser-managed value synchronization.

components.name: checkbox
components.description: A native checkbox with an enclosing text label.
components.accessibility: The enclosing label associates text without an id. Group related choices in a caller-owned fieldset with a legend. Radios in a group share a name and have distinct values.

components.name: radio
components.description: A native radio with an enclosing text label.
components.accessibility: The enclosing label associates text without an id. Group related choices in a caller-owned fieldset with a legend. Radios in a group share a name and have distinct values.

components.name: field-error
components.description: An explicitly identified error message for aria-describedby.
components.accessibility: Reference this id in the control describedby prop and mark invalid=true. The error is not a live region by default.

components.name: error-summary
components.description: A focusable validation summary with caller-owned field links.
components.accessibility: Give each summary a unique id if more than one is rendered. Link errors to actual control ids. This markup is focusable but does not automatically move focus; that requires the form/runtime integration.

components.name: disclosure
components.description: Native details/summary disclosure without JavaScript.
components.accessibility: Summary is the native keyboard-operable trigger. Do not place other interactive controls inside summary. Each disclosure is independent; no enforced accordion exclusivity.

components.name: table
components.description: A semantic table with caption and caller-owned header/body rows.
components.accessibility: Use tr elements in slots and appropriate th scope attributes. The caption is visible. The labelled wrapper is keyboard-focusable so overflowing columns can be scrolled with arrow keys. No sorting, row selection or grid keyboard model is implied.

components.name: breadcrumbs
components.description: A labelled breadcrumb navigation list.
components.accessibility: Supply li items. Mark the current page with aria-current=page and use text rather than a redundant active link. Separators are decorative CSS.

components.name: pagination
components.description: A labelled container for page navigation.
components.accessibility: Supply li items and real hrefs. Use non-links for unavailable actions and aria-current=page for the current page. No client-only pagination state.

components.name: empty-state
components.description: A centered empty result explanation and optional action.
components.accessibility: Use this for a real empty result, not as an error/loading substitute. The h2 assumes a page h1 already exists.

components.name: skeleton
components.description: A decorative placeholder for an explicitly labelled loading region.
components.accessibility: This is hidden from assistive technology. The caller must supply meaningful loading text and aria-busy on the actual region. No animation by default.

components.name: progress
components.description: A labelled native determinate progress indicator.
components.accessibility: Provide a meaningful label including progress if needed. Value and maximum must describe a real operation; this does not implement upload or polling.

layouts.name: layout-sign-in
layouts.title: Sign in
layouts.description: A welcoming account entry point with a branded panel, labelled fields and recovery guidance.
layouts.integration: Use your Portal authentication flow; never put credentials in query strings or client storage. The demo has no form or authentication endpoint. Fields are illustrative and the action is disabled.

layouts.name: layout-catalogue
layouts.title: Print catalogue
layouts.description: A responsive product collection with filters, sorting and a distinctive editorial product grid.
layouts.integration: Replace the six synthetic products with Lua loader output. Keep filter controls outside the results region; use a native GET form and a targeted live region when connecting search. This static example does not filter or navigate products.

layouts.name: layout-order-tracking
layouts.title: Order tracking
layouts.description: A clear production timeline, delivery details and an itemised order summary.
layouts.integration: Fetch the order through an authorised Lua read handler scoped to the current PortalUser and customer membership. Treat the order reference as an identifier, not permission to view an order. Tracking and totals here are fictional.

layouts.name: layout-order-request
layouts.title: Order request
layouts.description: A guided product configuration with artwork guidance and an adjacent quote summary.
layouts.integration: Keep editable configuration outside the replaceable quote region. Calculate and validate prices on the server. Wire submission to a protected Lua action; group related writes in the platform transaction capability. Connect authorised Folder uploads separately; this sample does not accept files or orders.
